original_target.title: Absolute continuity for smooth periodic scalar elliptic operators

scope_comparison: The required statement covers arbitrary smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic periodic principal matrix A in every d>=3. Schrödinger A=I, reflection, transversal and waveguide results impose extra structure. Simon weighted-L2 counterexamples are nonperiodic decaying potentials and do not apply here. The source general variable-metric conjecture remains distinct.
